nodes.text:
Why is that the spike in HMPV cases in China has caught the Indian media's attention but not similar spike in HMPV cases in the UK? The HMPV weekly positivity in the UK as of Dec 29, 2024 was 4.5%, which was slightly higher than what it was in 2023 (1/2)

nodes.author: RPrasad12
nodes.text: Is it because of photos of overcrowded hospitals were  shared on social media and it reminded the Indian media of COVID cases in Wuhan in 2019/2020? Or is it because of the inherent fear that China is once again in the midst of a "dangerous virus outbreak" but is hiding it? (2/2)
